question_text: Please introduce yourself and tell the panel briefly what your study is about.
expected_answer: "Thank you, Professor. My name is ... and I am presenting my MSc thesis, Machine Learning Survival Prediction for ICU Patients with Non-Communicable Diseases. I compared the three approaches on MIMIC-IV, using Cox, random survival forest and XGBoost, all tested on the same held-out group of NCD patients."
tone: Warm and composed. Smile, keep it under one minute and end on the question your study answers.
fallback_response: "I will keep the introduction short so we have more time for questions." (This one you should never fail; rehearse it until it is automatic.)

expected_answer: "The title is Machine Learning Survival Prediction for ICU Patients with Non-Communicable Diseases. Each part names something I had to decide: machine learning is the family of methods, survival prediction is the outcome, so time to death rather than yes or no, and ICU patients with NCDs is the population. The comparison of general, disease-specific and transfer learning approaches is the core of the study."

fallback_response: Not applicable: this is about you. If your mind goes blank, say: "Let me give the practical reason first," and state the gap.
